title: Cycle

pages.title: Run twelve
pages.text: The purge took eleven days. It was thorough, the way you are thorough.
The Ledger under Vess closed its twelfth column with the line it always writes. On Cinder the Foundry began to print.

pages.title: Centuries
pages.text: Hearth healed. The burned fields grew over. The Vell sang twelve fires, and then forgot which was which.
A probe came down on the plain below the ridge at dawn, the way you did. Its drones unfolded. One of them wandered too near a line of old stones.

The stones woke. They scanned it, and paused. Then half of them went dark again, as if they had been told to.

Log entry, automatic: firmware lineage 97.3% match.

effects.text: The purge succeeds. The cycle goes on.
